name: Susan Streible
quality: small; cropped from a group photograph at the native resolution of the digitised page, no upscaling
why: Associated Students group photograph on p. 153 of the 1968 Talisman, four rows on a flight of steps. The caption names 20 people in four rows and exactly 20 people appear. The front row of four is fixed by the four captioned officer portraits printed in the column beside it on the same page: Claudia Fowler is the only woman among the four first-row names and is third, and the only woman in the front row of the photograph is third. The second row holds six people and their sexes read woman, woman, man, woman, woman, woman from the left, exactly as the caption lists Streible, Jensen, Graham, Cheron, Cooper and Brockman, with Johnny Graham the single man in third place in both, so Streible is the leftmost person in the second row. Confirmed independently on p. 155, where the Executive Committee photograph stands seven people in one straight line for the seven names Larry Heishman, Bill Straeffer, Claudia Fowler, Susan Streible, Tom Evans, William Menser, Ron Beck: the line runs man, man, woman, woman, man, man, man, and of the two women the third has the long swept-back hair of the captioned Fowler portrait on p. 153 while the fourth has the short fringed bob of the face taken here. The left edge of the rows behind on p. 153 is anchored by the man in heavy dark-framed spectacles who matches the Michael Klein portrait this archive already publishes, Klein being named first in the third row.

name: David F. White
quality: small; cropped from a group photograph at the native resolution of the digitised page, no upscaling
why: Associated Students group photograph on p. 136 of the 1967 Talisman: nine seated at a table, then two standing ranks of nine and eight, 26 people for the 26 names in the caption. The seated first row was already fixed in this archive, its sexes running woman, man, man, man, man, man, woman, man, woman exactly as the caption lists them. Behind it stand 17 people for the 17 names in the second and third rows, and exactly five of them are women: the caption puts four women consecutively at positions four to seven of the second row and one, Marilee Jenson, at position seven of the third row, which is only satisfiable if the four adjacent standing women belong to the front standing rank. The two standing ranks alternate across the frame, the front rank sitting visibly lower in the picture at every point, and the alternation is anchored at the right-hand end by Mike Klein, the last name in the second row, who is the man in heavy dark-framed spectacles at the right end of the front rank and matches the Michael Klein portrait this archive already publishes. Reading the front rank left to right gives Weaver, Menser, White, so Dave White is the third man of the front standing rank, the one whose shoulder overlaps the white-shirted man behind him. The Talisman prints Dave White; the archive carries David F. White.
caption_quote: Second Row: Dale Weaver, Wenky Menser, Dave White, Vivian Denton
